instruction: A candid cinematic still, medium close-up, captures a couple in a cozy indoor room with a warm fireplace in the background. The woman in the white shirt (R1) sits in the foreground, leaning back against the bearded man in the beige t-shirt (R2) who sits behind her. Both have their eyes closed with peaceful expressions. He wraps his arms around her waist, holding her in a warm embrace. The scene is illuminated by soft, golden side lighting, creating a serene and intimate atmosphere with warm tones.
elements: R2 sits behind R1 and wraps his arms around R1's waist
R1 leans back against R2 while seated in front of him
R2 is the enclosing partner in the embrace while R1 is the enclosed partner
R1 and R2 both have peaceful expressions with eyes closed
a warm fireplace is visible in the background
